## Context / Problem

The Cloud Jira adapter still carries two dead private helpers. backend.py::_fit_description no longer has an executable consumer because the live send-path composition moved to the shared OutboundFieldMapper built with AdfCodec. acli_rest.py::_direct_rest_put also has no production caller and preserves the wrong issue-property envelope shape; the live issue-property, reporter, parent, and unassign flows already use concrete raw PUT writes instead.

Because both helpers are named in docstrings and held-out inventories, this cleanup must remove the dead code and retarget every surviving prose/test consumer to the real owners rather than leaving dangling references.

## Approach

1. Remove backend.py::_fit_description and keep Cloud description composition owned by the shared OutboundFieldMapper plus RichTextCodec path.
2. Update every prose/test consumer that still names _fit_description: adapters/jira/jira_fields.py, adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py, adapters/jira/backend.py comment prose, and tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py.
3. Remove acli_rest.py::_direct_rest_put and keep set_issue_property, set_reporter, set_parent, and unassign semantics on the concrete raw PUT implementations already used in production.
4. Update every stale _direct_rest_put consumer or inventory: adapters/jira/acli_rest.py comments, adapters/jira/acli.py unassign prose, tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py, and tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py.
5. Re-run focused Jira adapter/rich-text/raw-PUT suites, then lint, typecheck, and the default make test selector, treating test_atomic_completion_close::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head as the known pre-existing baseline failure if it is the only remaining broad-suite miss.

## Scope

- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/backend.py
- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/jira_fields.py
- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py
- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli_rest.py
- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli.py
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py
- tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py

## Testing

Run focused rich-text seam, raw-PUT transport, Cloud unassign, capability-probe, and Jira adapter inventory suites; then run make lint, make typecheck, and pytest -m "not integration and not external" -x -q.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] backend.py::_fit_description is removed.
- [ ] Cloud rich-text prose points at the shared OutboundFieldMapper plus RichTextCodec composition instead of the deleted helper.
- [ ] test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py guards the helper-name cleanup while preserving the send-path composition oracle.
- [ ] acli_rest.py::_direct_rest_put is removed.
- [ ] Issue-property, reporter, parent, and unassign paths still use the concrete raw PUT writes they used before the cleanup.
- [ ] The stale _direct_rest_put inventory/mock sites in test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py and test_jira_capability_probe.py are updated.
- [ ] Focused Jira adapter/rich-text/raw-PUT suites pass.
- [ ] make lint and make typecheck pass.
- [ ] pytest -m "not integration and not external" -x -q fails only on the known pre-existing atomic completion baseline test.
